provenance_qualification.disk_reference_semantics: exact match at checkpoints 10000 and 20000 on the full predeclared DEV reference parent
provenance_qualification.reason: two pre-CONF equivalence attempts failed on persistent edge-source-chain validation; the optimisation is quarantined and not used for CONF

primary_execution.timeout_interpretation: infrastructure safety ceiling only; a timeout is INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID and never an algorithmic all-loss-one scientific result
primary_execution.record_policy: one content-addressed JSON record per independent stream; no inferential summary in F10
primary_execution.source_policy: each stream is materialised exactly once inside its worker into separate feature and label tapes, re-read and SHA-256 checked before model consumption, then temporary tape bytes may be deleted after the content-addressed record stores their digests
primary_execution.elapsed_time_note: elapsed metrics are measured under the locked two-process/two-vCPU topology and must not be reinterpreted as uncontended latency
primary_execution.process_cpu_note: process_cpu_ns remains per worker process and is the preferred realised CPU quantity for later resource comparison

contextual_comparator_execution.same_source_bytes_requirement: regenerated CONF tapes must match the feature/label SHA-256 values emitted by the primary campaign for the same selected stream
contextual_comparator_execution.resource_role: contextual predictive/resource benchmark only; never H1-H3 identification

immutability_after_first_conf_value.repair_rule: implementation/infrastructure faults require an explicit versioned repair record and rerun of only affected planned units; no outcome-informed replacement, seed change or silent retry
